Six seams recorded with owning lane and required reconciliation: the dimensioning scope split correctly framed as two surfaces rather than a contradiction; PM020's edit-through Viewports and Sheet-local release held as superseded non-authority with the bans attributed to the correct objects; Publish-only Sheet vocabulary, PM034's controlling status authority, the Preferences seed-not-live boundary, and the licensed-access limit each dispositioned. S1 (standard/edition/convention selection) and S2 (unavailable/unlicensed-standard behavior) are named for the owner at ADS-C04; findings F1 (licensed primary-source acquisition as a conformance prerequisite) and F2 (a distinct Publish-documentation dimensioning disposition) are recorded as later-step work.
